jobs.title: Aluminium Top Clamp, the Z1’s preloaded first job

source.title: Makera Z1 Quick Start — Top Clamp

jobs.sentence: As Makera ships it, in aluminium, the job is refused: there are no feeds for the metal O-flute. On a plastic stand-in the app cuts the same part Makera’s own program cuts: the clamp, its slot, the two shoulders, the chamfered corners and three tabs.
jobs.modelled: Read from Makera’s own TopClamp.nc: a 65 × 20 mm clamp with 3 mm corner chamfers, a 52 × 6.1 mm through slot, 2 mm shoulders 3.5 mm deep at the front and left and 1 mm deep at the back and right, cut out with three tabs, on a 100 × 100 × 5 plate.

runs.title: Aluminium 6061, metal O-flute 3.175 mm — as Makera ships it
runs.refusal: no cutting parameters for a 3.175 mm cutter in Aluminium 6061: the starting table has no row for Aluminium 6061, and Makera's catalogue's rows are matched by Makera's own cutter id — which this cutter does not carry, so no row of theirs can name it. Pick a material the starting table covers, or a cutter Makera sells.

jobs.sentence: Cannot be described yet: there is no PCB material and no way to bring in the board’s Gerber layout. A hand-drawn board would test nothing, so none was made.

jobs.title: V-carved plaque: a dandelion and “Ruth”
jobs.sentence: With the house’s 90° bit the job is refused: the app reads the bit’s missing tip as 3.175 mm wide. With the 30° engraver the plaque cuts, with finer lines than the photo’s.
jobs.modelled: The “Ruth” plaque from the photo, ~100 × 62 mm. The dandelion is drawn from the photo as V-cut strokes (stem, head, 12 seed rays, 4 seeds blowing away). Oak stated as PLA.

runs.title: 90° chamfer bit (the house’s 90° V)
runs.refusal: Engrave text "Ruth" has nothing this cutter can reach: every stroke is thinner than a 3.175 mm 90° V-bit.

jobs.title: V-carve inlay of a round logo
jobs.sentence: The female pocket cuts with the 30° engraver, but no male plug can be made for a ring or for lettering, so there is no inlay. The 90° bit refuses the lettering, and on the guide’s star recipe it carves vertical walls 5 mm deep with a cone only 1.6 mm tall.
jobs.modelled: The round logo from the photo: a 60 mm ring 4 mm wide around “FF” (a serif face, not the logo’s script), 5.1 mm pocket and 1.3 mm glue gap from the guide.

runs.title: Female, 30° 0.5 mm engraver
runs.note: The male job is refused: “this job has no inlay region to make a male for”.

runs.title: Female, 90° chamfer bit
runs.refusal: Engrave text "FF" has nothing this cutter can reach: every stroke is thinner than a 3.175 mm 90° V-bit.

runs.title: The guide’s star recipe, male plug, 90° bit (3.8 mm)
runs.note: Generated, but a 3.175 mm 90° bit’s cone is 1.6 mm tall: the walls below that are cut by the body of the bit, vertical.
